### Jesus Prays
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/greg-laurie-devotion-april-10-2025.html
Passage: Matthew 26:42
Points:
- Facing the crushing weight of human sin and God's wrath, Jesus retreated to Gethsemane to pray.
- His closest disciples repeatedly fell asleep, leaving Jesus to endure His deepest agony alone.
- Jesus asked if the cup of suffering could pass, but the Father's answer was no.
- Submitting to God's plan granted Jesus deep peace, courage, and resolve to face His arrest.
- Prayer teaches believers that God's plan is supreme and that surrender is the best conclusion to every prayer.

### The Garden of Surrender
Author: Lynette Kittle
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-nightly-prayer/the-garden-of-surrender.html
Passage: Matthew 26:39
Points:
- Jesus withdrew into the quiet solace of an olive garden on the eve of His crucifixion.
- In intense emotional and physical anguish, He honestly asked if there was any way to avoid the suffering.
- Despite the agonizing prospect of humiliation and death, He did not waver in yielding to the Father.
- Christ's struggle shows that expressing distress to God is natural when facing difficult assignments.
- Believers are invited to follow Christ’s example by surrendering their own wills to God during trials.
